summary: Evaluates JSON Logic rules against input facts using precompiled engine.build()

ports.name: Evaluate
ports.text: Triggers evaluation of the precompiled rule against the input facts

ports.name: Input Facts
ports.text: Facts or context object against which the rule is evaluated

ports.name: Rule JSON
ports.text: JSON Logic rule object or JSON string

ports.name: Matched
ports.text: Triggers when the evaluated rule result is truthy

ports.name: Result Payload
ports.text: Output value or payload produced by the evaluated rule

ports.name: Not Matched
ports.text: Triggers when the evaluated rule result is falsy

ports.name: Is Matched
ports.text: Boolean flag indicating whether the rule matched (true) or not (false)
